story.title: Story 2: Inference Seam and Model Assignment

result.reviewScopeSummary: Verified Story 2 AC-1.1 through AC-1.4 and TC-1.1/TC-1.2 against the story, tech design, test plan, implementation, fixtures, and gates. createSdk now enforces provider/inference XOR, validates complete assignments, builds the inference adapter into the provider slot, and routing tests inspect actual ModelCall inputs across all seven kinds and mixed lanes.

verified: AC-1.1: createSdk rejects both provider and inference and rejects neither with TypeError naming exactly one of provider or inference; evidence packages/lhc/src/sdk.ts:370-374 and packages/lhc/test/inference-construction.test.ts:43-60.

AC-1.2: ModelCall boundary is provider/model/messages only with structured success/failure result types; adapter calls the host function with only that shape. Evidence packages/lhc/src/inference/types.ts:10-31 and packages/lhc/src/inference/adapter.ts:33-39.

AC-1.3: assignment validation iterates FORM_KINDS, rejects unknown keys, missing kinds, unknown prompt names, and empty provider/model before adapter construction. Evidence packages/lhc/src/sdk.ts:321-358 and packages/lhc/test/inference-construction.test.ts:63-107.

AC-1.4: each adapter operation routes by its own FormKind assignment, and tests prove all seven kinds plus three-lane mixed provider routing. Evidence packages/lhc/src/inference/adapter.ts:19-24 and :68-75, packages/lhc/test/inference-routing.test.ts:34-111.
TC-1.1: inference-construction.test.ts covers XOR, missing each kind, unknown prompt, unknown kind key, empty provider/model, and valid drain to ready; focused and full gates passed.

TC-1.2: inference-routing.test.ts plus seam-conformance helper cover actual logged ModelCall inputs, provider/model routing, message shape, mixed lanes, and recordingCall contract conformance; focused and full gates passed.

gatesRun.command: cd packages/lhc && pnpm exec vitest run test/inference-construction.test.ts test/inference-routing.test.ts

additionalObservations: Production-path audit found no material fake adapter, hardcoded default provider/model, credential handling, API client construction, or fallback transport path in src/ for this story.
